annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/666 of 22 April 2021 amending Regulation (EU) No 923/2012 as regards requirements for manned aviation operating in U-space airspace
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/666 of 22 April 2021 amending Regulation (EU) No 923/2012 as regards requirements for manned aviation operating in U-space airspace
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union (L 139/187)
annotation.summary_en: EU Implementing Regulation amending the Standardised European Rules of the Air to require manned aircraft in U-space airspace, without air traffic control service, to be electronically conspicuous to U-space service providers, so they can safely share airspace with unmanned aircraft systems. Applies from 26 January 2023.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines 'U-space airspace' as a UAS geographical zone designated by Member States where UAS operate with U-space services.
Defines 'U-space service' as digital, automated services supporting safe UAS access.
Manned aircraft in U-space airspace without ATC service must continuously be electronically conspicuous to U-space service providers.
Replaces SERA.6005 on communications, SSR transponder and electronic conspicuity requirements.
Applies from 26 January 2023; binding and directly applicable in all Member States.
